meta.title: iSDA Keyword Index
meta.purpose: Full inventory of DDS keywords iSDA's visual designer exposes, organized by level and UI category, for comparison against IBM i SDA's own screens and to power quick keyword search/navigation.
notes: Extracted directly from src/webviewClientHelpers.js and src/dspfWriter.js (ground truth), cross-checked against docs/sda-reference/screens/* (real SDA reference screenshots) during the A1/A2 audit.
'category' matches the exact picker tab/accordion label shown in iSDA's own UI.
'sharedWith' lists other record/field types that reuse the same panel (e.g. R1's 8 panels are reused by SFLCTL, WINDOW, PULLDOWN, MNUBAR, etc. - see docs/sda-reference/PICKER-SCREENS-PLAN.md).
Repeatable/multi-instance keywords (CHECK, ERRMSG/ERRMSGID, SFLMSG/SFLMSGID, record indicator keywords) are listed once with 'repeatable: true' rather than once per sub-code.
This file is generated by hand from a point-in-time audit (2026-09-05) - it is NOT auto-synced with the codebase. Re-run the same extraction if keywords are added/changed.
